section_summary.extract_value: This procedures section describes the recruitment and data collection methodology for a study conducted in Brazil. Participants were recruited opportunistically from various community sites including on-campus locations, shopping malls, and fashion stores, and completed paper-and-pencil questionnaires. The study was approved by the University of Campinas Ethics Committee and was limited to participants aged 18 years and above.

The study was approved by the Human Research Ethics Committee of University of Campinas in São Paulo, Brazil, and was limited to participants aged 18 years and above with no remuneration provided.
